verdict.rationale: An agent can read experiment configuration programmatically: the Admin API offers full programmatic access to feature flags, and variants are documented for A/B and multivariate testing. The official MCP server also lets LLM assistants manage flags and debug targeting. However, nothing shows that experiment results (variant performance, statistical outcomes) can be retrieved through the API or MCP; impact metrics drive automated rollout safeguards but are not documented as agent-readable results. missing for 10: programmatic access to experiment results and variant-level outcome metrics, statistical analysis output usable for ship/rollback recommendations, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven experiment summarization.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
Automate milestone progression or trigger safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold.
